description: This file defines types, functions, and a class for managing node subscriptions and messaging in a server context, including subscribing, unsubscribing, and sending messages to nodes or sessions.

classes.name: NodeSubscriptionManager
classes.description: A class managing node and session subscriptions, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, and message dispatching.

methods.name: createNodeSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a new NodeSubscriptionManager object with subscription and messaging methods.
